name: PixReveal
summary: PixReveal is a browser-based pixel art guessing game in which an image is progressively unveiled pixel by pixel, rewarding players who can identify it the fastest. The game features several ways to play: a Classic single-player mode, a rotating Daily Challenge with global rankings, a local Jackbox-style Party mode for groups (players join via QR code and use their phones as buzzer controllers, no app install needed), Online multiplayer for playing remotely, and additional singleplayer variants including Survival and a gravity-based reveal mode. A dedicated Twitch Stream mode lets streamers display the game on their channel while viewers compete to guess the picture live via the Twitch chat. Party matches include a powerup system that lets trailing players disrupt the leaderboard, along with a robot moderator that reacts to events during the game. PixReveal also includes a built-in pixel art editor, letting players create and share their own drawings for others to guess.
